purpose: A non-secret semantic map of important Aperture screens for documentation, support agents, and UI automation. It contains no wallet state or user data.

screens.title: Wallet Home
screens.purpose: Show the selected wallet's portfolio and provide entry points to Send, Receive, Search, wallet switching, scanning, and Settings.

screens.title: Universal Search
screens.purpose: Search local wallet actions, settings, wallets, networks, assets, and transactions.
screens.source_deep_link_status: implemented for Aperture 2.40.12; public association pending App Store release

screens.title: Currency Converter
screens.purpose: Compare one editable amount across supported crypto, fiat, and precious-metal reference rates.
screens.source_deep_link_status: implemented for Aperture 2.40.12; public association pending App Store release

screens.title: Receive Asset Selection
screens.purpose: Choose the asset and mainnet before displaying a receive address or request.
screens.source_deep_link_status: implemented for Aperture 2.40.12; public association pending App Store release

screens.title: Send Asset Selection
screens.purpose: Begin a send by choosing an asset and mainnet from the active wallet.

screens.title: Transaction Details
screens.purpose: Explain a transaction's status, hash, network fee, addresses, explorer actions, and local note.
screens.sensitivity: contains user financial data and public addresses

screens.title: Settings
screens.purpose: Navigate wallet, security, language, currency, network-provider, notification, privacy, and about settings.

screens.title: Security Settings
screens.purpose: Configure app passcode, Face ID, auto-lock, and app-switcher privacy behavior.
screens.source_deep_link_status: implemented for Aperture 2.40.12; public association pending App Store release

screens.title: Wallet Management
screens.purpose: Manage existing wallets and accounts and enter the app's explicit add, import, export, or removal flows.
screens.sensitivity: wallet configuration; credential and destructive actions remain separate explicit flows
screens.source_deep_link_status: implemented for Aperture 2.40.12; public association pending App Store release

screens.title: Import Wallet
screens.purpose: Choose recovery phrase, private key, encrypted iCloud backup, or direct iPhone transfer as the import method.
safe_agent_actions: compare import methods without requesting credentials

screens.title: Physical Entropy Input
screens.purpose: Collect fair dice outcomes, coin flips, or digits toward on-device wallet entropy.
safe_agent_actions: warn against sharing outcomes or recovery words

automation_rules: Treat labels, values, headings, and hints from the live accessibility tree as authoritative over this catalog.
Never read, record, transmit, or request recovery phrases, private keys, BIP-39 passphrases, app passcodes, or backup secrets.
Never authorize, sign, or broadcast a transaction without the user's explicit in-app action and review.
Public deep links are omitted unless the installed production app currently handles them.
Source deep links must be labeled as pending until their matching App Store build and apple-app-site-association paths are live.
